snippet.title: GigaBash - Ultraman Zero DLC: Official Trailer
snippet.description: Celebrate #UltramanDay with the ultimate clash of light and darkness! The Land of Light graces the GigaBash - Ultraman Zero DLC, coming out on July 9 @ 20:00 PDT! Wield power in the name of justice as #UltramanZero or for power's own sake as #UltramanBelial in the #GigaBash arena!
